text_description: Runway look built around a bold red, black/navy and white striped ensemble, worn full length with a fluid, layered silhouette. The upper layer appears as an oversized long shirt or shirt-dress with strong vertical striping, a red center button placket with visible buttons, a loose straight body that hangs past the hips, and long sleeves with open, slit-like side panels that create flapping drape at the arms; the neckline and collar area are largely covered by a brightly patterned neck scarf tied in a large bow, mixing red, yellow, black and white graphic motifs. Beneath or continuing from the shirt layer is a long skirt or dress section with clashing stripe directions: vertical stripes at the sides and a prominent diagonal chevron-like front panel in red, black/navy and white, creating asymmetry and movement. The lower hem falls to the ankles with wide dark border panels, and the front opening/slit reveals one leg while walking, emphasizing a breezy, swinging runway motion. Accessories include small tinted sunglasses, visible earrings, and pale yellow strappy lace-up high-heeled sandals. The overall styling is maximal, graphic and coordinated, with crisp high-contrast stripes, scarf print layering, and a polished resort/runway mood.
